svg.title: PREDESTINATION — The temporal agency loop
svg.desc: Worlds and Thread atlas. Story order progresses downward. Connections use reserved routing space. Full relationship and citation ledgers follow the chart. The HTML companion contains the complete accessible model.
svg.text: 2D · categorical world columns · Story-order ranks, not elapsed time. Equal ranks do not assert physical simultaneity.
Amber S± — Split outcomes. + and − are signs, not fates.
Blue T — Directed transfers. B body · M memory · C consciousness · S signal · ? literal/unspecified mechanism.
Emerald V / L — Numbered visits and explicit links only. Emerald centre on a cable means the route follows that connection.
Slate rail — World identity. Cutoff means chart boundary, not destruction. Crossings are bridges; only markers are joins.
Evidence / fate — [n] opens the evidence record. × dead · ● alive · ? unknown · ∅ nonexistent. Purple dotted connections are
